note: Field definitions and the honesty guards enforced by data_p3_forms.validation(). The build fails if any guard breaks.

grades.DOCUMENTED: multiple primary forms read and cited

sentinel_classes.non_report: 0 recorded because the institution did not report
sentinel_classes.in_progress: 0 recorded because the ranking cycle was incomplete
sentinel_classes.placeholder_key: DIPP0000-style filler where a join key was required
sentinel_classes.multi_value_cell: several values in one scalar cell; not a number
sentinel_classes.blank_not_zero: empty cell that a sibling column encoded as 0

guards: a form may only be counted when parse_status == parsed
every numeric 0 in the corpus must carry a sentinel explanation
a DOCUMENTED finding must rest on >= 2 forms
every verbatim quote must trace to a mined form and a real finding
no interview-style claim wording is permitted anywhere in this module

fields.lost_at_join: dpiit_recognised - dpiit_in_trl; startups that lose identity
fields.reverse_gap: dpiit_in_trl - dpiit_recognised; keys with no recognised row
